primary_title: Microglial neuropilin-1 promotes oligodendrocyte expansion during development and remyelination by trans-activating platelet-derived growth factor receptor
decision_basis: Primary NRP1-Fc, microglia-specific deletion, PDGFRalpha phosphorylation and anti-PDGFRalpha blockade support cross-cell NRP1 transactivation of OPC PDGFRalpha and the associated proliferation output.
limitations_preserved: Preserve NRP1 on microglia, PDGFRA on OPCs, PDGF-AA/trans-cell context, developmental/remyelination comparator and no traumatic-SCI/terminal-TF inference.

primary_title: A novel microglial subset plays a key role in myelinogenesis in developing brain
decision_basis: CD11c-Cre Igf1 depletion and myelin readouts support the source-specific CD11c-positive microglial IGF1-to-primary-myelinogenesis output.
limitations_preserved: Preserve neonatal CD11c-positive microglia, conditional Igf1 deletion, IGF1 source/protein and developmental timing; no adult/SCI or receptor/terminal-TF inference.

primary_title: M2 microglia and macrophages drive oligodendrocyte differentiation during CNS remyelination

primary_title: Interleukin-1beta Promotes Repair of the CNS
decision_basis: IL-1beta knockout, glial IGF-1 protein measurements and remyelination readouts support an IL-1beta-associated glial IGF-1 production bridge, bounded as support/correlation rather than direct receptor causality.
limitations_preserved: Preserve mixed microglia-macrophage/astrocyte source, IGF-1 protein output, knockout/temporal semantics and cuprizone comparator; no IL1R/SCI/terminal-TF inference.

primary_title: Microglia trigger astrocyte-mediated neuroprotection via purinergic gliotransmission
decision_basis: Low-dose methylmercury, VNUT dependence, microglial ATP release and astrocyte P2Y1 knockout support the MeHg(low)-activated microglia-derived ATP-to-astrocyte P2Y1 edge.
limitations_preserved: Preserve MeHg(low), VNUT-dependent ATP, astrocyte P2Y1 and mixed-glia/slice comparator; no SCI or terminal-TF inference.

primary_title: Microglia trigger astrocyte-mediated neuroprotection via purinergic gliotransmission
decision_basis: P2Y1 knockout astrocytes lose MeHg(low)-evoked IL-6 protein release, supporting the receptor-to-secreted-cytokine output.
